name: IncottKeycap
source_reference: design brief only: the app's own UI design language (ui/style.css tokens; the mouse line art in ui/index.html readout screen). No logo, no bitmap reference.
brief: The lit white key: paper-white stage, graphite mouse silhouette engraved on it, one green connected-lamp dot.

semantic_review.basis: original concept authored in-task from the app's own design language; no external brand mark and no bitmap reference to reproduce
semantic_review.notes: Inverse of IncottLitMouse: the stage is the colour of the app's lit main button, the mouse is near-black ink. Highest contrast on both dark and light taskbars.

app_context.job_to_be_done: let the user recognise the mouse driver in the taskbar, Start menu and installer at a glance
app_context.tone: calm, precise, hardware-instrument; no AI-flavoured purple, glow or gradients

style_direction: custom direction from the app UI (单色仪表台); nearest built-in family: silver-field-black-mask

source_analysis.fidelity_target: same mouse silhouette as IncottLitMouse, inverted values

spec_constraints: rounded rect overlay in background colour

acceptance_checks: preview and app PNG inspected at full size and 64px

composer.reason: background-coloured overlay: an open groove from the top edge ending in the scroll wheel, no cutout
the one meaningful accent: connected lamp
